forcedChoices.choice: tú from 'Are you also hard of understanding?' to the end of the paragraph

«maligno» is a short form of 'devil' in the glossary; «malo» keeps the two terms apart.
The glossary gives «diablo/diablos» for 'devil'; «demonios» is kept only for 'prince of devils', as the glossary gives.
Spanish has no other natural vocative; it is the same form as the title 'Master', but here it is a plain address.

forcedChoices.choice: «la marea ... se volvió hacia el reflujo» for 'the outward turning of the tide'
forcedChoices.reason: Spanish needs a word for the direction of the tide; «reflujo» is the tide that goes out.
